findings: RS3 retains the seven illustrated lamella levels, wider upper lids and lower skirt, separate inclined bracket, two rods and lower nuts. Wall profiles and hardware details remain inferred.
The shield section now passes through its own center, rather than the overall bracket bounding-box center; the head and first closed ceiling are visible.
S-THB includes a separate white cap, black receptacle, inline adapter, uninterrupted lead meshes and terminal connector. Adapter shape and coil rest pose are original hypotheses.
Cinch reference supplies a selected six-contact connector envelope. Its latch and open cable entry are visible; this does not identify the Onset plug supplier or establish U30 fit.
Original white-plastic geometry is lit with shadows to expose lamella spacing; illumination and reflectance are not calibrated.
geometry_limits: A sub-millimetre cable turn detected during inspection was replaced with a 15 mm egress arc; the minimum remaining discrete radii are 4.68 and 6.85 mm.
Static cable geometry has no gravity settling, stiffness or strain-relief qualification.
Nominal thread overlaps remain explicit and are not physical thread contact.
Wind sensor, tripod, anchoring, U30 socket cavities and complete installation are still open.
